title: EZ-Bar Reverse Curl
summary: An overhand-grip curl for the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: EZ curl bar or barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for forearms (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly forearms total.
Library rating 0.6 for biceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly biceps total.

setup.text: Hold an EZ bar overhand at shoulder width, arms straight.
Curl it up, keeping your wrists straight.

form_cues.cue: Use less weight than a regular curl and keep the wrists neutral.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias, Wrist-extensor focus (back of forearm).
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch, Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less brachialis & brachioradialis bias, Static hold, More grip demand.
